Data Setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtern)

water_data <- read.csv("data/FieldChemData.csv")

scarp_sites <- c("FSV1", "BST1", "MPL1", "SRT1", "JPY1", "LSR1")
dip_sites   <- c("MCD1", "SCH1", "CHY1", "DFT1")

water_data <- water_data |> 
  mutate(
    Mountain_Side = case_when(
      Site %in% scarp_sites ~ "Scarp",
      Site %in% dip_sites   ~ "Dip",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Mountain_Side = factor(
      Mountain_Side,
      levels = c("Scarp", "Dip")
    ),
    Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
  )

element_cols <- names(water_data)[
  !names(water_data) %in% c("Site", "Date", "Mountain_Side")
]

water_data <- water_data |> 
  mutate(across(
    all_of(element_cols),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", as.character(.x)))
  ))
```

Theme (from poster, might need to tweak for paper)
```{r}
poster_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

poster_colors <- c(
  "Scarp" = "#6B5A8E",  
  "Dip"   = "#C76A2A"   
)
```

Major Solute Concentrations
```{r}
poster_elements <- c("Ca", "Li", "Mg", "Si")

poster_data <- water_data %>%
  select(Mountain_Side, all_of(poster_elements)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(poster_elements),
    names_to = "Element",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )

n_A <- poster_data |> 
  group_by(Element, Mountain_Side) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(label = paste0("n = ", n))

fig_A <- ggplot(
  poster_data,
  aes(x = Mountain_Side, y = Concentration, fill = Mountain_Side)
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_A,
    aes(x = Mountain_Side, y = -Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Element, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = poster_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Major Solute Concentrations",
    x = "",
    y = "Concentration (ppb)"
  ) +
  poster_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 28, 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(fig_A)

ratio_data <- water_data |>
  mutate(
    Mg_Ca = if_else(is.finite(Mg) & is.finite(Ca) & Ca > 0, 
        Mg / Ca, NA_real_),
    Na_Ca = if_else(is.finite(Na) & is.finite(Ca) & Ca > 0, 
        Na / Ca, NA_real_),
    Mg_Na = if_else(is.finite(Mg) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0,
        Mg / Na, NA_real_),
    Ca_Na = if_else(is.finite(Ca) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0,
        Ca / Na, NA_real_)
  )

x_labs_bulk <- c("Scarp" = "Scarp", "Dip" = "Dip")

```
Piper Plot
```{r}
cbPalette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

piper_fig <- water_data %>%
  ggtern(aes(x = Ca, y = Mg, z = Na, color = Mountain_Side)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = poster_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Major Cation Composition",
    T = "Ca",
    L = "Mg",
    R = "Na"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    
    tern.axis.title.T = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    tern.axis.title.L = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    tern.axis.title.R = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    
    tern.axis.text.T = element_text(size = 18),
    tern.axis.text.L = element_text(size = 18),
    tern.axis.text.R = element_text(size = 18),
    
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

piper_fig
ggsave("piper_fig.png", piper_fig, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```


Bulk Ratios
```{r}
ratio_df <- ratio_data |>
  select(Mountain_Side, Mg_Ca, Na_Ca) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mg_Ca, Na_Ca),
    names_to = "Ratio",
    values_to = "Ratio_Value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Ratio = recode(Ratio,
      Mg_Ca = "Mg / Ca",
      Na_Ca = "Na / Ca"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(Ratio_Value), !is.na(Mountain_Side))

n_under <- ratio_df |> 
  group_by(Ratio, Mountain_Side) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(label = paste0("n = ", n))

fig_ratios <- ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = Mountain_Side, y = Ratio_Value, fill = Mountain_Side)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_under,
    aes(x = Mountain_Side, y = -Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Ratio, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Scarp" = "Scarp", "Dip" = "Dip")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = poster_colors, name = "Mountain Side") +
  labs(
    title = "Bulk Ratios",
    x = "",
    y = "Molar ratio"
  ) +
  poster_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 24, 10)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(fig_ratios)
ggsave("Fig_bulk_ratios.png", fig_ratios, width = 16, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

Magnesium/Sodium x Calcium/Sodium
```{r}
ratio_scatter <- water_data |> 
  mutate(
    Mg_Na = if_else(is.finite(Mg) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0, Mg / Na, NA_real_),
    Ca_Na = if_else(is.finite(Ca) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0, Ca / Na, NA_real_)
  ) |> 
  filter(
    is.finite(Mg_Na),
    is.finite(Ca_Na),
    !is.na(Mountain_Side)
  )

fig_ratio_scatter <- ggplot(
  ratio_scatter,
  aes(x = Ca_Na, y = Mg_Na, color = Mountain_Side)
) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = poster_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Mg/Na vs Ca/Na",
    x = "Ca / Na",
    y = "Mg / Na"
  ) +
  poster_theme

print(fig_ratio_scatter)

ggsave("Fig_MgNa_vs_CaNa.png", fig_ratio_scatter, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
Discharge Comparison
```{r}
q_file <- "data/q_all.csv"
q_all  <- read_csv(q_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

q_daily <- q_all |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(dt),
    stream = str_trim(toupper(stream)),
    stream = case_when(
      stream == "BEAST" ~ "Scarp",
      stream == "MDH"   ~ "Dip",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(stream)) |>
  group_by(date, stream) |>
  summarise(Q_ls = mean(q.ls, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

shared_dates <- q_daily |>
  count(date) |>
  filter(n == 2) |>
  pull(date)

q_plot <- q_daily |>
  filter(date %in% shared_dates) |>
  mutate(stream = factor(stream, levels = c("Scarp", "Dip")))

ggplot(q_plot, aes(x = date, y = Q_ls, color = stream)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Scarp" = "#6A3D9A", "Dip" = "#E66101"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Discharge (L/s)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("shared_discharge_timeseries.png", width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
